connector.name: FEA (finite element analysis)
connector.registryDescription: Real FEA on CAD parts: validated setups, stress, safety factor, natural frequencies
connector.summary: Hosted at therobomaster123--mcp-fea-mcp-endpoint.modal.run over streamable HTTP. Needs a bearer token header, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the therobomaster123 account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A bearer token is sent in a request header. Store it outside the config file wherever your client supports it.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Bearer token issued by the operator (value of the mcp-fea-token Modal secret, as 'Bearer <token>')
